contentComprehensiveness.explanation: 回答覆盖了 `Option Explicit` 的核心意义，明确指出它强制变量声明（'enforces the requirement for all variables to be explicitly declared before they can be used in the code'），说明了放置位置在模块顶部的通用声明区（'placed at the beginning of a module, typically in the General Declarations section'），并列举了防止拼写错误、提高代码清晰度与可靠性、便于调试维护等好处（'prevent the creation of undeclared variables, which can lead to errors such as misspelled variable names going unnoticed.
